subject: botany
question_text: Identify each part in a flowering plant and write whether it is haploid (n) or diploid (2n): (a) Ovary (b) Anther (c) Egg (d) Pollen (e) Male gamete (f) Zygote (g) Antipodal (h) Megaspore mother cell.

mark_split.label: Eight parts at half a mark each

verification.note: Chapter 6 is sourced from the Junior Fastrack botany guide (book p.16), which prints the question and a model answer but NO star ranks and NO year citations. Only ONE source book is held for botany — the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand covers physics only, and no botany board paper is in the corpus — so the two-book union check and the board-paper back-test are both structurally impossible for this card, not merely pending. The half-mark-per-part split is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. The book prints 'Mega spore mother cell' (spacing); the card writes megaspore mother cell. The book's eight answers themselves are correct and the card agrees with all of them.

insider_note: Examiners award half a mark per part; the two usually lost are the megaspore mother cell (2n, not n) and the antipodal (n, not 2n).

steps.why: With this rule none of the eight answers needs memorising: place the part before meiosis (2n), after meiosis (n), or after fertilization (2n).
common_mistakes: Writing the list without the rule — one slip then goes unnoticed.
steps.memory_tip: 2n → meiosis → n → fertilization → 2n. Every part sits at one of the three positions.
steps.margin_note: Two lines of rule first — no marks here, but it prevents slips.

steps.label: The eight answers

lines.text: n = after meiosis · 2n = body cells and zygote

steps.why: Ovary and anther are organs of the diploid plant; the megaspore mother cell is a mother cell, still 2n. Pollen, egg, male gamete and antipodals all come after meiosis, so n. The zygote is the fusion product, 2n again.
common_mistakes: Marking the megaspore mother cell n — it is a MOTHER cell, still 2n; only its meiosis products are n.
Marking the antipodal 2n — antipodals are cells of the embryo sac (gametophyte), so n.
Marking pollen 2n because it sits inside a 2n anther — the pollen grain itself is a meiosis product, n.
steps.memory_tip: The two trap items: anything called 'mother cell' is still 2n; anything inside the embryo sac (egg, antipodal) is n.
steps.margin_note: Write all eight on separate lines with (n)/(2n) — half a mark each.
